name: Fused Spline Interpolation Predictor + Quantizer
description: Multi-level spline interpolation predictor fused with error-bounded quantization (cuSZ-Hi port). 2-D and 3-D only (1-D rejected). Four forward outputs: codes (TCode[N]), anchor (TInput[~N/4096]), outlier_vals (TInput), outlier_idxs (uint32_t). ABS/NOA/REL modes resolve to a single absolute bound (NB: REL is global-approximate eb*max(|x|), not exact per-element PFPL; use QuantizerStage for exact REL). Error bound is a target; max element-wise error is typically ≤1.1×eb on smooth data, up to ~2×eb near outliers. Auto-tuning (setAutoTuning 1/3/4) optimizes INTERPOLATION_PARAMS; 3-D-only for modes 1/3/4. 3-D double path requires dynamic shared memory ≥77 KB (Volta+). Patched local fix for upstream spline_infprecis_data 2-D level-0 atomic offset collision (documented in THIRD_PARTY.md).

config.name: errorBound
config.description: Error bound value. Interpretation set by errorMode.

config.name: errorMode
config.description: ABS = absolute; NOA = value-range relative eb*(max-min); REL = pseudo-REL eb*max(|x|) (global-approximate, NOT exact per-element PFPL — use QuantizerStage for exact REL).

config.name: quantRadius
config.description: Quantization radius. 0 = auto-tune on first execute (scans input min/max; requires D2H sync, incompatible with graph capture). >0 = use this radius directly.

config.name: outlierCapacity
config.description: Fraction of input size reserved for outlier storage.

config.name: autoTuning
config.description: INTERPOLATION_PARAMS auto-tuning mode. 0=off (deterministic baseline). 1=cheap (reverse[] only). 3=full structural (use_md, use_natural, reverse per level). 4=full+alpha/beta sweep. 5=manual alpha/beta override (graph-safe). Modes 1/3/4 are 3-D-only; incompatible with CUDA graph capture.

paper.title: Boosting Scientific Error-Bounded Lossy Compression through Optimized Synergistic Lossy-Lossless Orchestration
paper.authors: Shixun Wu, Jinwen Pan, Jinyang Liu, Jiannan Tian, Ziwei Qiu, Jiajun Huang, Kai Zhao, Xin Liang, Sheng Di, Zizhong Chen, Franck Cappello
